attributes.action: When it hits a certain temperature children shouldn't have to do school.
attributes.additional_details: This petition is about helping children not have to sit in a hot and smelly room for multiple hours and make it so children feel comfortable while the heat begins to rise and it gets hotter. children should still do the work from the comfort of their own home and this shouldn't effect attendance.
attributes.background: I want the government to make it so children don't have to go into school during the heat or make it so there is good air conditioning.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

Legislate a statutory maximum temperature for classrooms and fund school cooling
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/774023
